shorts_extract.hook: Why trying to calm an anxious mind with thoughts often fails—while two quick inhales and one long exhale flip your brain's stress brake in seconds.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Balban, Spiegel & Huberman (2023, Stanford Medicine RCT, N=108): 5 daily minutes of cyclic sighing beat 5 minutes of mindfulness meditation on mood and resting breathing rate.
shorts_extract.twist: The second tiny sniff pops open collapsed lung sacs to dump CO2, while the long exhale mechanically activates your vagus nerve and quiets the amygdala (Herrero et al., 2018).
